body:
## Summary

#23 is closed, but its third requirement, "Publish the package to npm", is not delivered. `npm view @link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer` still returns 404. On `main`, the merge commits of both #14 and #25 have red CI, so no release is attempted.

## Failing workflows on main @ c9714cb

**Checks and release** ([run 37830784369](https://github.com/link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer/actions/runs/37830784369)):
- *Release Preflight*: `FAIL: npm OIDC package exchange rejected (404); configure a trusted publisher or bootstrap token` → `refusing to release with 1 refused credential(s)`. npm has no trusted publisher for this package/workflow, and there is no bootstrap `NPM_TOKEN`. A brand-new scoped package needs either a first publish with a token or a trusted publisher configured on npmjs.com for `link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer` + `release.yml`. This may need an org owner, so please document the exact steps.
- *Test (bun on windows-2025)*: the step `Run tests (Bun)` fails with no failing test in the log. Output stops after `tests\check-file-line-limits.test.js`, which looks like a crash or hang of the Bun process. It passed on the PR branch, so it is flaky or depends on the merge.

**Example app** ([run 37830784426](https://github.com/link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer/actions/runs/37830784426)):
- *Build web app*: `Get Pages site failed ... HttpError: Not Found`. GitHub Pages is not enabled for the repository. Either enable Pages (build from GitHub Actions) or skip the Pages deploy steps when Pages is not configured.

The same Example app failure also occurred on the #14 merge ([run 37769979635](https://github.com/link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer/actions/runs/37769979635)), so main has been red since 2026-10-08.

## Expected

- Release preflight configured (trusted publisher or bootstrap token), and the first version published. `npm view` returns a version, and the package installs and runs (`npx @link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer --version`).
- Bun-on-Windows test step reproduced and fixed (or the crashing test identified), not retried away.
- Example app workflow green: Pages enabled, or deployment made conditional.
- CI on `main` green after merges. PR checks alone did not catch any of these failures, so consider a required post-merge status or running the preflight on PRs.
title: npm package still not published (#23) and main CI red: release preflight OIDC 404, Pages disabled, Bun Windows crash
